entries.8e31d79c25ac616b: These are wireless communication module products essential to mobile connectivity devices in IoT. entries.b0b3c197b043cd1a: This business develops and sells mixed-signal LSIs for various applications. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 is ¥2,830 million. Based on its proprietary analog and logic design technologies, it sells application-specific standard products (ASSPs) under its own brand and also licenses circuit design assets (IP) obtained through product development. Manufacturing is outsourced to domestic and overseas foundries in a fabless model, and subsidiaries in Taiwan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Shenzhen and the United States handle product marketing and sales support.
entries.c2b773d52f680697: These are LSIs that transmit image data at high speed. It also sells, to LCD panel manufacturers including those for automotive equipment, products that combine a receiving transmission LSI and an LCD panel controller on a single chip. Revenue by product category is not disclosed.
